incoming.explanation: The same Norwich institution-book search that would identify the 1627 clergyman Warford would document the wardship presentation.

Blomefield locates the presentation at the Gurney-held West Barsham living and shows why its 1627-28 institution is invisible there, narrowing the open Warford search to the Norwich diocesan institution books and pointing to the Crown (Master of the Wards) as the likely patron of record during Edward's minority.

outgoing.explanation: The open Warford identity is raised by, and turns on, the 1627 letter.

statement: The clergyman 'mr. Warford' whom Mrs. Gurney presented in 1627 is unidentified: no Warford of any spelling appears in Venn's Alumni Cantabrigienses (to 1751), and none in Foster's Oxford register beyond too-early Bristol men. The Norwich diocesan institution registers (the Clergy of the Church of England Database) are the remaining route, and his institution would name the Gurney-held advowson.
